comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Root cause identified and fixed:

1. **Missing `SELF_CONTAINED` compilation symbol** — The `#if !SELF_CONTAINED` preprocessor directive in `ProgramRoot.cs` (lines 51-119) was never evaluated as true because the build scripts didn't pass `-p:DefineConstants="SELF_CONTAINED"`. This caused runtime checks for .NET and VC++ to always execute, even in self-contained builds.

2. **Missing `IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract`** — Native dependencies (e.g., SqlClient SNI) weren't being bundled properly...
